title: Great way to save
text:
Back in the day, my bank used to have something called Christmas Club where the bank would automatically put your chosen amount from your checking to Christmas account, and in December you would have money saved up. That never worked for me because I always would up using it for other things.

I am now using my Amazon Gift Card as a Christmas Club. Every month I move a certain amount from my checking account to the card. The best part is, I can't use it anywhere but Amazon. So, I can't decide that I want to go out to a posh restaurant just for the hell of it, my money is safely at Amazon where I can't get it. That's a good thing, because I do most of my shopping at Amazon anyway, and now, I'll have "free" money to spend for Christmas, or save up for something my family really wants.

The manager seemed very nice until I called him a week later when my ATM card didn't work. He instantly said thee appears to be fraudulent activity regarding the checks, everyone I spoke with on the phone lied. The check is in the Mail, we will send you another check tomorrow, blah blah blah! So in may 2018, 8 months later and because I use to work for a bank which is covered under Federal Jurisdiction, I finally called the FBI. I said I'm sorry to bother you with this issue, but the FBI considered this a White Collar Crime and sent an Agent to my house and I had that check for $8000 in a week. And a week later $14,400 in auto deposits that were due me. The Chase Credit Card Division and the Banking Division  are two separate entities. The credit card people have been great, however I am starting not to use that card whenever possible as a matter of principle and there is NO REASON why I have to have a CHASE checking account to get an Amazon DEBIT Card.
